title: Refused completion returns to its retained worker
description: Private authenticated gateway fixture with a controlled instruction adapter and file-backed worker loop. Proves gateway sequencing and saved signal freshness; does not launch or certify a real provider pane.

proofTargets.claim: The real send-back RPC forwards the exact completion refusal to its selected retained adapter context.
The previous file signal cannot enter COMPLETE after send-back, including an independently read persisted snapshot.
A later file signal enters COMPLETE through the monitor continuation without another dispatch.
A second send-back reconciles the original uncertain instruction instead of sending another one.

prove.intent: Exercise send-back through a private authenticated gateway and retained worker fixture.

delivered.intent: Require the exact refusal at the selected adapter context.

old.intent: Require COMPLETE to wait while the previous source signal remains.

fresh.intent: Require the next source signal to enter COMPLETE through monitoring.

reconciled.intent: Require one observation of the original instruction on retry.
